title: Give OLY-7-06 a defect-discovery figure in the athena status keep rule
summary: Retry of job 20261029-204938-yatb (dispatched, never verified, no findings, no candidate changes): same reading as accepted before. Add a defect-discovery figure beside the landed share in the keep rule of `athena status` (later-cited defects and verifier-found defects per verified job, older vs newer window, "discovery weakened" flag, "not enough data" when thin), and record it as OLY-7-06's mechanism with a measure ending `status: keep rule`. Audience: Hestia and the owner reading `athena status`.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check the weakened-discovery flag firing and not firing, not just that fields exist.
Too few verified jobs reports 'not enough data' rather than improvement.
fmt, clippy and test criterion included.
Requirement gets a code mechanism recorded in spec.toml.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Previous result (job 20261029-204938-yatb): it recorded no findings and no candidate files, so there is nothing to fix or keep from it; its accepted reading and deliverables are reused, with crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs added because it prints the keep rule. Nothing from that job is dropped because no changes exist.

Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs (keep_rule, later_harm, later_causes, KeepRule, LaterHarm already measure later-cited defects per planned/unplanned group; keep_verdict rests only on share and cost), crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs (keep_rule_output at ~line 621 renders the keep rule check; line ~4186 holds a spec measure test using 'status: keep rule'), crates/athena-data/src/records.rs (Verification and Finding records carry verifier findings per job) and a grep of crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs (prints the keep rule). No new record kind or data file is added, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are untouched; the figure is derived from existing records.

Entry point: `athena status` calls status::keep_rule(records) which builds KeepRule; the new discovery struct is computed in the same function from records and added as a field so JSON serialization (Serialize derive) includes it. The property is measured directly from verifier findings and later citations per verified job, split into older and newer halves by job id order.

The discovery flag is reported only: keep_verdict thresholds and landing are unchanged; weakened means later-cited defects and verifier-found defects per verified job both fell between windows. Fewer than a minimum count of verified jobs per window yields 'not enough data'.

Spec measure label `keep rule` is already a line `athena status` prints; the xtask spec test for labels is exercised by cargo test (xtask has no library target, so any test there goes in xtask/tests/ or src unit tests).

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, docs/spec.toml are extended, not created.
Governance: athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows need no change.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-7-06 has a mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs and the new discovery figure (no longer 'none'), owner still Hestia, and a measure ending `status: keep rule`.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core status`: a new test builds records where later-cited defects and verifier-found defects per verified job both fall between an older and a newer window and asserts the status view flags discovery as weakened; a second test with steady discovery asserts no flag. The first test fails when the discovery computation is removed.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core status` and `cargo test -p athena-cli`: the keep rule text in `athena status` output contains the discovery counts (defects found by verification, later-cited defects, verified jobs per window) beside the landed share and cost, and the serialized JSON of the keep rule includes them.

Run `cargo test` (including xtask): the spec test accepting the measure label `keep rule` passes for OLY-7-06, and a test with too few verified jobs shows 'not enough data' rather than an improvement (no-empty-success).
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`; all pass, and existing keep_rule tests keep the same verdicts.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the discovery figure; the diff touches only the listed deliverables.

out_of_scope: Changing the keep verdict thresholds or making the discovery flag block any job or landing
Editing athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, or other requirements in docs/spec.toml
New record kinds or changes to records/
departures: Slightly lower verification pass odds: the prior attempt was dispatched but never verified, and the change spans core and CLI display.
